RECOMMENDATION

 Erlotinib/Gefitinib/Afatinib drugs show maximum response in Exon 19 deletions or L858R. Response to above mentioned drugs for wild type EGFR is not well known. Patient with T790M positive for lung cancer are recommended for Osimertinib treatment. However, patient care and treatment decisions should only be made by the physician after taking into account all relevant information available for patient’s condition, as well as other clinical details such as the current standards of care.

METHODS

This test useful for the detection of exon 19 deletion (p.E746_A750deletion), Exon 20 point mutation (T790M) and Exon 21 point mutation (L858R). EGFR gene mutations are actionable targets of existing and emerging anti-cancer therapies, and have prognostic features in specific tumor types.

The test uses droplet digital PCR (ddPCR) wherein upto 20000 droplets are produced which act as individual PCR reactors giving unparalleled sensitivity.

The sensitivity of the assay depends on the quality of the sample and depends on the tumor stage and content. On standard DNA obtained from HD the sensitivity the sensitivity of the assay is 0.1% while the specificity is 100%

LIMITATION

The test will not detect mutations located in other regions of the genes that are not analyzed (other exons, non-coding exon sequences, intron sequences other than the splice junctions, and upstream and downstream sequences). The mutations have not been confirmed using Sanger sequencing and/or alternate technologies and additional testing might be required if clinically indicated. False negative results may be due to sampling error/errors in sample handling as well as clonal density below the limit of detection.
